Recycling in Chicago? Let’s get it right!Chicago’s Blue Cart program makes recycling easy for homes and buildings with four or fewer units. Live in a larger building? You can recycle, too! Just check with your building manager or recycling provider to see what they accept. Rules may be different depending on who collects your recycling.
